text:
jamie: Morning — finishing onboarding checklist. I completed Okta SSO but I can't reach the internal Console (console.redwood.internal). When I try https://console.redwood.internal my browser just times out. Any tips? I'm on corp VPN with split-tunnel on macOS.

nadia: hey @jamie — split-tunnel often means internal DNS/routes aren't pushed. Are you on the 'corp-vpn' profile? Can you run `scutil --get State:/Network/Global/IPv4` and paste the output? :thinking:

jamie: yep I'm on corp-vpn. I can reach git.redwood.com (public) but traceroute to console.redwood.internal stops at 10.8.0.1.

eli: ^ that sounds like the client isn't receiving the VPC DNS. On mac you can try `sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder` after connecting. If you just need quick access you can use the bastion as a proxy:

```bash
# SOCKS proxy via bastion
ssh -D 1080 jamie@bastion.redwood.com
# then set browser proxy to localhost:1080
```

nadia: if you need to ssh directly to a service behind the VPC you can use the jump host:

```bash
ssh -J jamie@bastion.redwood.com svc-internal-host
```

jamie: ssh -D worked — I can load the console via the SOCKS proxy now. Is that a permanent fix or should I open a ticket so IT can push DNS/routes correctly?

nadia: please open a ticket with IT (tag it `vpn: split-tunnel dns`) so they can check the VPN profile and DNS routes. Ping @it-support and include your Okta email and OS.

it-support: thanks for the ping @nadia. Filing ticket #INC-4521 to investigate DNS over VPN. @jamie please attach a screenshot of `scutil --dns` and confirm your macOS version so we can repro.

jamie: attached the `scutil --dns` output to the ticket, macOS 13.5.1. Thanks for the fast help :raised_hands:

oncall-infra-bot: Note: bastion maintenance scheduled 2025-09-12 02:00-03:00 UTC. There will be brief reboots; plan accordingly. :rotating_light:

eli: also FYI we have a short onboarding doc in #docs/networking that explains split vs full-tunnel for new hires. I'll DM the link to you.

jamie: got it, thanks everyone!
